proposals.evidence: DEDR 4410 explicitly attests Tamil/Malayalam pēr, Kota pēr, Telugu pēru, Gadaba/Parji pidir, Gondi peder/porol, Tulu pudaru and Konda/Kuvi dōru name. The selected simple name nouns fit these branches; Indo-Aryan nām forms and potentially contact-mediated Kannada pēru are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5440 compares Tamil viṟaku and Malayalam viṟuku firewood. These neighbouring survey lects show the same full v/b-initial, r-medial firewood stem, with voiced, unvoiced or weakened medial stop and source-final central vowel preserved; this is a comparative placement, with local inheritance versus contact still open for review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5373 documents Tamil/Malayalam vāḻai/vāḻa, Kannada bāḻe and Kota vāy vaṇ plantain; DEDR4004 independently documents paḻam/paṇ/paṇṇu fruit, including Irula pammu/pāmu and Kota paṇ. Propose the ordered banana-plant + ripe-fruit components for these surveyed whole words. Their lateral/rhotic/glide, p/h and final-vowel differences are preserved. This is a comparative compound analysis for this survey lect, not a claim that every spelling or lect is printed in DEDR; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. More heavily contracted forms without two identifiable constituents are excluded.
